content: {"summary":"Prime delivery promises are increasingly unreliable, with many members reporting 3‑ to 4‑day delays instead of the advertised 2‑day window [tk_2868365]. Customers also struggle to cancel unwanted Prime subscriptions, citing confusing sign‑up screens that lock them into the service [tk_2061568]. Frequent missed delivery notifications and lack of proactive communication frustrate users, who feel their premium status is not honored [tk_2621074]. Overall, the perceived value of Prime is eroding, leading to cancellations and negative word‑of‑mouth [tk_594545]."}
